protocol.scope: Owner-authorized noncommercial exploratory development on previously inspected D2 data; not a fresh holdout, native usefulness result or model admission
protocol.hypothesis: Under the same small visible-rating budget, recent complete rating-entry groups may adapt a durable residual estimate better than the earliest groups.
protocol.training: Exactly D2 regular-subject training rows and configuration; verify original membership, partition hashes and cutoffs. Fit once per independent run. Held-out-subject rows never enter any global fit. No hyperparameter search or selection.
protocol.targets: Every D2 held-out-subject rating at or after the original training cutoff. The full target set is identical across every policy/budget/variant. These reused development outcomes are not untouched final evidence.

prefix.availability: Subject's complete strictly earlier rating-time groups, including pre-training-cutoff history; score each whole current group before appending any current labels. Global artifact never updates.
prefix.earliest: Take the longest contiguous prefix of complete groups whose cumulative row count fits the budget; stop at the first group that does not fit.
prefix.recent: Walk backward from the latest prior group, retaining whole groups until the next group cannot fit; stop without skipping it. Return the contiguous suffix in chronological order.
prefix.ties: No partial timestamp group, arbitrary within-group ordering or current-group evidence. Oversized boundary groups may leave zero usable prefix.
prefix.missing: Unknown training items remain in subject state; factorization uses the declared durable-state fallback when no prefix item has fitted factors. Zero support and cold items remain in every denominator.

primary.contrast: recent minus earliest RMSE, paired on exact subject/object/time identities
primary.uncertainty: 500 seeded paired subject-cluster bootstrap replicates, jointly resampling all rows per subject; descriptive exploratory intervals only
primary.decision: Report direction, interval, support and material-gain threshold. Regardless of outcome, no selection, promotion, native integration or new final claim.

diagnostics.metrics: MAE/RMSE, subject-macro errors, absolute error quantiles, fixed cold/tail/supported item slices, finite/component coverage and paired policy intervals for the same variant/budget
diagnostics.prefixSupport: Query-weighted and target-row-weighted actual size and oldest/newest age in days; empty eligible history, oversized-group blocking and zero selected prefix counts separately
diagnostics.cost: Fit and total run times, selector and forecast times separately, peak process RSS and artifact bytes

protocol.replay: Two independent fits/evaluations must match numeric parameters, predictions, all metrics/prefix summaries and deterministic result hash; timings and runtime resource peaks are excluded from equality.
protocol.publication: Only authored code, this protocol, aggregate reports and hashes; subject membership, histories, prediction journals and fitted parameters remain private/ignored. Existing source rights/withdrawal rules remain in force.
protocol.nativeAdmission: deferred; research-only source rights, quality, mapping, compatibility, isolation, trace, fallback and device gates remain separate

parentProtocol.scope: Noncommercial offline development, not a shared benchmark or native serving admission
parentProtocol.hypothesis: Train-only collaborative features and ordered rating-entry prefixes may improve the same hidden observed-rating task over a shrunken item mean and durable subject state.
parentProtocol.target: Original observed explicit rating on 0.5–5; no implicit negatives, probabilities or causal outcomes
parentProtocol.candidateProtocol: Exactly the actually rated object in each held-out row; all models score identical targets. No ranking, recommendation exposure or candidate-recall claim.

split.subjectSelection: Lowest SHA256(seed + ':' + namespaced subject ID), no rating-value selection
split.cutoffs: Timestamp at floor(q * non-held-out rows); train < trainBefore, validation [trainBefore, testFrom), final >= testFrom. Equal-time groups never split.
split.frozenBatch: Global artifacts and subject prefixes use training rows only; validation labels never join final frozen-batch state.
split.prequential: Same frozen global artifacts; final state starts with permitted training and validation history, then only that subject's strictly earlier scored test groups. Score the entire equal-time group before updating.
split.coldStart: Held-out subjects are excluded from all global fits and validation selection. Reveal earliest complete timestamp groups strictly before testFrom without exceeding the prefix budget. Score identical final-window targets at every budget; report actual prefix sizes, including zero when a group exceeds the budget.

features.metadata: Off: undated release metadata and tags are not historical inputs
features.state: Raw long-term mean and three most recent complete rating-time-group means, normalized by the fixed target scale; residual state uses train-only item means
features.neighbors: Positive cosine of item-centered training vectors, overlap shrinkage, train-popularity top 1000 items, at most 20 neighbors
features.factorization: Seeded SGD squared explicit-rating error, fixed shrunken item offsets, learned user bias and user/item vectors; score subjects by ridge fold-in of their permitted prefixes against frozen item vectors
features.memory: Train-only prefix plus known continuation; exact target object, different subject, no future labels in distance. Stable seeded record selection with no response-value sampling; static versus ordered distance on the same bank. No fabricated actions or viewing trajectories.

selection.rule: One fixed configuration per variant. Select lowest validation frozen-batch RMSE, tie by declared candidate order. Save selection and model hashes before opening final evaluation. No refit, parameter sweep or final-test reselection.
selection.finalRule: Development validation only if selected variant improves validation RMSE by >=0.01, paired subject-bootstrap final RMSE difference upper95 < 0, and cold-item RMSE degradation <=0.1 when at least 20 subjects support that slice. Otherwise reject or defer for inadequate support. Native serving always deferred.

metrics.uncertainty: 500 seeded subject-cluster percentile bootstrap replicates; resample subjects with all their rows, preserving paired model/reference errors. Descriptive development uncertainty, not population guarantees.
metrics.slices: All; train item support 0 (cold), 1–9 (tail), >=10 (supported); train subject support 0 versus >0; controlled held-out subject prefixes
metrics.coverage: Finite predictions, supported component versus fallback, eligible memory counts, neighbor use and explicit no-match; one common denominator including cold items
metrics.errorDistribution: Absolute-error p50, p90, p95; row-weighted and subject-macro errors
metrics.resources: Training component times, query-batch p50/p95 and total evaluation times, Node process peak RSS, artifact bytes; exclude IO/bootstrap from model latency

artifactPolicy.absenceInvalidWithdrawal: Fail closed to a native-only observed-prefix mean or unavailable; never reuse any externally fitted means, vectors or memories as the withdrawal fallback
artifactPolicy.publication: Aggregate report, hashes and protocol only; histories, subject memberships, partitions, predictions and fitted parameters remain ignored
artifactPolicy.withdrawal: Stop all uses of the dependent artifact, remove derived model/index/caches from use, rebuild from separately authorized inputs and rerun evaluation; deleting raw rows or setting one coefficient to zero is insufficient
artifactPolicy.nativeAdmission: Deferred: separate rights, canonical mapping, native usefulness, isolation, compatibility, trace, fallback/rollback and device gates

limitations: Previously inspected D2 outcomes: exploratory development only, not a fresh final test or a shared benchmark.
Rating-entry chronology is not consumption history, recommendation exposure, native product uplift or causal evidence.
Whole-group policies can retain different actual row counts; the primary contrast is policy effect at a maximum budget, not pure recency at equal information.
Subject bootstrap intervals describe this selected cohort, without correcting dataset selection or diagnostic multiple comparisons.
Only original regular-subject pre-cutoff rows train global artifacts; later held-out answers only update that subject after scoring.
No book ratings, cross-domain transfer, Shared behavior, native serving integration or artifact admission is established.

verification.interpretation: Two independent fits of the fixed exploratory study; no test-driven tuning. Training parameters reproduce original D2 after restoring its code-manifest-bound artifact ID. The support fallback correction affects inference only. Historical D2 outputs remain unchanged.
